P14_fix_orphan_sweep.detail: maintenance_service.is_orphaned() splits on '__' and orphans a pair only when a half is genuinely gone. Verify: a backend start on a machine with completed runs should free 0 MB.

P15_bugs_found_by_the_browser_check.detail: Four real bugs the build could not have caught. (1) useTissueType cleared its cached report on an inputsKey that step 7 changes a moment after load, while the cache lookup keyed on uploadId alone - so step 8 offered a 10-30 min recompute on EVERY already-processed slide. (2) QCPanel's failed-probe branch had no Skip, so a failed QC probe was a dead end with no way forward. (3) compartments fetch timed out at 30s when the real cost is ~18s cached and minutes uncached. (4) client reported timeouts as 'signal is aborted without reason'. Also: SlideOverlayViewer rebuilt the whole OSD viewer whenever draw() changed; fly-to focus framed the field so loosely that its own cells fell under the draw threshold.

P16_verified_in_browser.detail: steps 11-15 photographed zoomed in on the real CD44 and ABCC4 slides: nuclei light blue, classes red/amber/green, compartments red nucleus + green measured membrane ring, per-cell DAB ramp, bins grey-to-amber. Shots in walkthrough_shots/ and walkthrough_shots_F/. Delete tested on a synthetic case - removes from both trees.

P17_membrane_shell.detail: A membrane marker measures the outer 1.5um of its 4um body instead of the whole annulus, so nucleus/cytoplasm/membrane are three disjoint regions. A 65->60, F 95->90, R 60->55; U and W untouched. Verified in the browser.
